Regional Openings Overview

Recent professional listings for media, communications, outreach, and related advocacy roles across Central Washington highlight opportunities with multiple regional employers, including educational institutions, healthcare organizations, and event producers. Based on professional networking platform data, positions range from academic and community outreach to specialized medical marketing and seasonal production.

Listings aggregated from the region detail several active and recent postings spanning Moses Lake, Mattawa, Hanford, George, and Coulee City. While the platform provides application pathways, specific details regarding compensation, exact application deadlines, and structured selection processes are largely omitted from the public summaries.

Specific Roles and Employers

  • Big Bend Community College (Moses Lake, WA): Advertised roles include an Outreach Coordinator, Director of Outreach, and Associate Faculty positions in Communication.
  • AbbVie (Mattawa, WA): Listed a Head of Marketing role for Retina Eye Care.
  • Connoisseur Media (Moses Lake, WA): Listed an Account Executive position.
  • Caltech / LIGO Lab (Hanford, WA): Posted a Science and Outreach Intern position.
  • Insomniac Events (George, WA): Listed a Seasonal Production Assistant role for Boo! Seattle 2026.
  • Johnson & Johnson / Johnson & Johnson MedTech (Coulee City, WA): Advertised a Senior Thought Leader Liaison in Lung and Head and Neck Oncology, alongside a Regional Advocacy Director position.
  • Catholic Charities Serving Central Washington (Mattawa, WA): Listed a Resident Services Coordinator role.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For professionals evaluating these opportunities, reviewing the primary platform listings is essential to determine current application status, as many postings are marked as early applicants or active searches from previous weeks.

Confirmed Details:

  • Employers and general geographic locations.
  • General functional categories including media, communications, outreach, marketing, and advocacy.

Unconfirmed or Not Specified Details:

  • Salary ranges and benefits.
  • Exact application deadlines.
  • Detailed selection processes and specific eligibility criteria.

Readers can examine the complete, up-to-date listings and utilize the direct application steps by visiting the official source page on LinkedIn at [Media and Communications Jobs in Moses Lake, WA](https://in.linkedin.com/jobs/media-and-communications-jobs-moses-lake-wa).
